promised_vs_delivered.delivered: Targeted for FY27; execution status remains pending as of Q3 FY26 reporting.
Scheduled for completion within 8 months from Jan 2026; status remains pending in Q3 FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management stated PAT expanded by 60 percent year-on-year to INR433 crore in Q3 FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Dec 2025 PAT reached INR 433 crore, rising 59.8% YoY from INR 271 crore in Dec 2024.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management reported Chemicals Business revenue grew 22 percent year-on-year to INR1,825 crore in Q3 FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Total Q3 FY26 revenue rose 6.4% YoY to INR 3,713 crore from INR 3,491 crore in Dec 2024.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management cited persistent customer pricing pressure from Chinese competitors impacting specialty chemical performance.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Annual OPM decreased from 25.4% in FY21 to 18.5% in FY25 before recovering to 21.6% in FY26.

bull.point: Revenue growth accelerated sharply in FY27 quarters, reaching 31.8% YoY in Jun 2026 (INR 5,033 crore) and 34.7% in Sep 2026.
Cash flow generation remains robust with 3-year cash conversion at 1.614 and free cash flow reaching INR 1,265 crore in FY25.
Solvency remains comfortable with net debt to EBITDA at 1.311 and debt-to-equity ratio low at 0.362 in FY26.

bear.point: Operating margins remain compressed relative to peak levels, dropping from 25.4% in FY21 to 21.6% in FY26 due to pricing pressures.
Working capital cycle elongated over 3 years by 13.85 days to 59.86 days in FY26, driven by higher debtor days.
Specialty chemicals financial performance faces ongoing pressure from Chinese competitor capacity additions and customer pricing demands.

watch.point: Commissioning progress of the INR 180 crore second pharma intermediate plant at Dahej site.
Execution status and outlay for stage one Odisha site investment targeted between INR 1,500 to 2,000 crore.
Operating margin resilience and revenue momentum in light of persistent Chinese competition and pricing pressures.
